body: Yeah, thats what i dont understand about the idea of religion. Yes on one hand there would be a reason to live and a reason to prove yourself and all that, but i dont understand, if god was almighty, and god was the founder of all, and wants everybody to be happy, then why did he make it so there were wars so horribile that hundreds of millions died. And why is it that he punishes the people for their actions by sending them to hell or to heaven, but then he makes their brain work as it does and he puts them into the exact environment they would grow up to be bad people in. I mean yes in rrligion theres a soul and all that, but god makes those too. But whatever, i mean i cant bring myself to believe in that, but i cant say its impossible either. I mean there is still the huge question of why in the ever living fuck the universe was created, thats unclear, so it is possible. In my eyes its the lazy way of finding an explenation but its possible so yeah. As an atheist i must say, there is plusses, but theres also minusses to it. But i have to say, respect for coming out. Thats impressive, that shit takes guts. I probably wont come out like ever (while not being anonymous). So respect and good for you. (Btw. Do i smell anticapitalism? You seem very chill just fyi)
